VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Delhi and Beijing have faced the exact same pollution problem!!! They were both Urban Gas chambers with a terrible air condition!!!
But today while Beijing looks like this, Delhi looks like this!!! Back in January 2013, Beijing's air got so toxic that breathing it on the worst day was like smoking about 25 cigarettes and The world called it an air apocalypse.
In 2017, China had 75 of the world's 100 most polluted cities.
And then, something unbelievable happened. Today, out of the 100 most polluted cities in the world, India has 66, while China only has 5 cities.
